title: GAIA-2: A Controllable Multi-View Generative World Model for Autonomous Driving

output_modality.value: multi-camera video, up to five cameras at 448 x 960

control_signal.value: ego speed and curvature, 3D boxes of dynamic agents, metadata (country, weather, time of day, lanes, traffic lights), CLIP text or image embeddings, scenario embeddings

control_mechanism.value: ego action and flow-matching time injected by adaptive layer norm; other conditioning variables by cross-attention; inpainting and scene editing via masked or partially noised latents at inference

base_model.value: latent flow-matching world model: 8.4B-parameter space-time factorized transformer, 22 blocks, over a learned video tokenizer with DINO distillation

datasets.value: large multi-country driving data (UK, US, Germany) balanced on joint feature distribution, with geofenced held-out validation; dataset not named in packet

metrics.value: FDD and FID for fidelity, FVMD for temporal consistency, class-wise IoU of projected 3D boxes against OneFormer segmentation for agent conditioning

controllability_evidence.value: Dynamic agent conditioning scored by IoU between projected boxes and segmentation masks; qualitative action-driven and agent-driven safety-critical scenarios. No numbers in packet.

closed_loop.value: Open-loop only: autoregressive rollout with sliding window of k = 3 context latents under ego conditioning; no driving policy in the loop stated.

notes: Future-work text is cut off in the packet, so limitations may exist. Scenario embeddings come from an internal proprietary model.
